question: Can positive correlation-moment readout approximate the same retained-branch R-first CRPS value with certified local error and useful stable/computational behaviour against strong exact implementations?
required_assumptions: Finite simplex posterior and every reachable outcome branch retained
Open-interval finite correlations; positive known scales/weights
Same actions, budgets and posterior for every comparator
Tail bounds apply to model-based two-stage terminal CRPS value, not full agent regret or physical calibration

exact_small_rational_panel.loss_units: sqrt(pi)*CRPS gain; exact Fraction moments/coefficients/tail and rational sqrt enclosures for full kernel
required_fixtures: D1-ranking reversal: w=1/2, b1rho=(3/4,-3/4), b2rho=(1/8,1/8); certify true b1 using81/2048>1/64
Fixed versus adaptive R-first branches kept; one-sided value error and policy-regret bound checked
PSD/Loewner truncation and posterior-dependent tail bound
Known-relation/no-relation and homogeneous-scaling/separable controls; do not manufacture H by duplicates
Symmetric ±rho=1e-8: D2 positive shape term vs high-precision reference AND stable rationalized H2 closed form
Near1 correlation requiring exact fallback at declared degree cap
Exact nonzero final value outside float64 range: explicit failure/log/interval rather than silent0
Tiny posterior branch mass retained; no support deletion

bounded_performance_panel.degree_cap_rule: min(64,floor(number_of_distinct_relevant_hypotheses/4)); if no certified degree within cap use exact comparator, and99/100is an explicit fallback control
bounded_performance_panel.profile_generation: Declared deterministic known-state correlation function; include same-rho separable control and count all proxy-specific moment construction. If using exact low-degree polynomial family, include its shared-polynomial-moment strong shortcut. Do not use arbitrary fitted/random per-candidate rho tables or duplicate hypotheses as alleged material evidence.
bounded_performance_panel.scope_of_timing: Preprocessing, posterior branch construction, rho/features, moments or kernel, scoring, fallback and numeric workspace included; one-shot implementation observation not universal speed ranking
bounded_performance_panel.memory_accounting: Report shared posterior/input memory separately plus true algorithm workspace; do not force exact baseline to store all outer products or all kernels

error_and_decision_certificate.restricted_policy_regret_bound: max_a U_a - max_a L_a <= max_feasible epsilon_b, only same retained-branch two-stage terminal model
error_and_decision_certificate.full_policy_choice_certificate: Certify first action AND every reachable second-action branch; otherwise refine/fallback
error_and_decision_certificate.numerical_error_requirement: Analytic tail excludes rounding/posterior approximation. Exact small panel uses rational scaled gain; float performance panel must not claim strict IEEE certificates without additional rigorous numeric envelopes.

required_negative_decisions: D comparable to H, no benefit relative to exact support-restricted calculation
r too close1 or interval gap unresolved: fallback not forced truncation
Homogeneous/separable profiles: analytic ordering or shared simple closed form may be optimal
Best exact blocked/vectorized baseline already faster/smaller: no-go extra efficiency layer
Only general Taylor facts established: classic adaptation, no topconference-method claim
future_execution_gate: Root must separately approve implementation, then exact code/plan/inputs freeze and independent audit before any execution. This template authorizes none.
